source.collection: 193 frozen synthetic inputs through the normal official public calculator UI, no email/account/direct calculation API. All13 visible properties independently extracted from downloaded PDF text and normalized for whitespace only. 26 gate.lines plus defined channels/centers directly observed from rendered SVG, not inferred from PDF text or engine values. PDF diagram is an image; no second independent diagram transcription claimed. Not a blind population or real birth dataset.

transcription_crosscheck.scope: FNV1a32 is a non-cryptographic transfer crosscheck against the separately held rendered DOM observations, not authenticity proof. Original PDFs are separately SHA256-bound.
